{{Quote|Very vicious, giant, mammalian carnivores, boar-wolves prey on anything that comes across their path.|[[Lyrre T'enna]]'s notes on the boar-wolf.|<ref name=":2" />}}
The '''boar-wolves''', or '''borra''', were a predatory animal that lived on the forest moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Boarwolf-howl.png|thumb|left|250px|A howling boar-wolf]]
Boar-wolves had been known to be three meters tall.<ref name=":0">{{DB|creature|boarwolf|boar-wolf}}</ref> They had hair, sharp teeth, a humped back,<ref name=":1">''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]''</ref> two tusks<ref name=":2">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> and large, hooked claws<ref name=":1" /> that could tear holes in trees. They had pungent and stringy meat.<ref name=":3">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>

They had a penchant<ref name=":3" /> for howling at the gas giant [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]] when it appeared in the night sky.<ref name=":1" /> With a keen sense of smell,<ref name=":0" /> they usually hunted in pairs for prey such as [[Blurrg/Legends|blurrgs]] and [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], preying anything that came across their path.<ref name=":2" /> These truly impressive predators possessed an incredible patience to hide and wait out of sight once they have cornered their prey, having fed on many Ewoks this way.<ref name=":3" />

==History==
Tough the boar-wolves are three times as tall as the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], they had somehow stumbled upon effective methods for fighting the monsters with spears and poison darts. The Ewoks first baited a clever trap with scraps of bloody meat from other kills and carefully hide a vine net on the forest floor. When a boar-wolf attempted to rip into the fresh meat, the net tangles around its huge armored body, enough to slow and confuse it while the Ewok hunting party charges out of the underbrush. One such kill provided enough meat to feed an Ewok tree village for days, if one could stomach the pungent and stringy meat.<ref name=":3" />

[[File:Gorax-woswfg.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A [[Gorax/Legends|Gorax]] with pet boar-wolves]]
Bear-wolves were sometimes semidomesticated by the primitive [[Gorax/Legends|Gorax]].<ref name=":2" /> A Gorax would find a boar-wolf mother who had gone to ground in a cave to give birth to a litter. The Gorax then smashed open the whelping place, killed the mother, and choosed a boar-wolf to take as a pet.<ref name=":0" /> In keeping with its own fondness for bodily ornamentation, the Gorax would strap leather collars and harnesses on his pup, raising it as a hunting companion.<ref name=":3" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]<ref name="Star Wars: Behind the Magic">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> one deadly<ref name="DB-Towani, Mace">{{DB|character|macetowani|Towani, Mace}}</ref> domesticated boar-wolf chased [[Cindel Towani|Cindel]] and [[Mace Towani]] through the forest after they left the home of [[Deej Warrick]], trapping them inside the hollow of a tree trunk. In the morning, Deej and his three sons [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket]], [[Widdle Warrick/Legends|Widdle]], and [[Weechee Warrick|Weechee]] went searching for the children and found the boar-wolf lurking in the vicinity. Deej and his two elder sons fought the creature using spears. The boar-wolf was ultimately killed by Wicket, who shot it with a poisoned dart from a blowgun. Upon emerging from their hiding place (from which they witnessed the battle), Mace and Cindel found their [[Jeremitt Towani|father's]] [[Life monitor/Legends|life monitor]] attached to the boar-wolf's collar, put there as an ornament by its owner, a giant Gorax who lived in the [[Forbidden Fortress of the Gorax|Forbidden Fortress]].<ref name=":1" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Maldien]] conducted illegal and highly dangerous [[bioengineering]] experiments in a [[Illegal Lab (Corellia)|laboratory]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to create very aggressive and intelligent creatures. This included at least one engineered boar-wolf.<ref name="SWG:CMCOtZ">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Coronet Murmurs: Clear Out the Zoo|Corellia}}</ref>
